source.citation: Shahbazi, Menard, Sohn, Theau (2019), Unmanned aerial image dataset: Ready for 3D reconstruction. Data in Brief 25, 103962. DOI 10.1016/j.dib.2019.103962

processing.method: Binned height-field mesh using maximum observed TLS Z per populated grid cell, with small enclosed interior no-data gaps filled from neighboring TLS cells.
processing.triangleWinding: counter-clockwise from +Z / upward-facing for app FrontSide rendering

interiorGapFill.method: Small enclosed no-data cells are filled from surrounding TLS cell heights before meshing.

processing.fillPolicy: Small enclosed interior no-data gaps are filled from neighboring TLS heights before meshing. Mesh faces are still not extended outside the observed TLS footprint. Exterior boundary loops are spline-smoothed in scene space to remove binned-grid edge chatter without stitching to the outer surface.

sceneTransform.note: Surface preview keeps TLS metric scale, recenters X/Y, and lifts Z into the existing procedural Case Study B scene.

reviewStatus.notes: This is a TLS-derived preview, not a final DEM, photogrammetry mesh, or engineered surface. It fills only small enclosed interior display gaps and does not extend the mesh outside the observed TLS footprint.
